gaps: Only the explicitly delivered table batch (blocks block-001171-76355f56 through block-001175-5be4846e) was in scope; other statement sections, notes and prose blocks of the filing remain pending and were not reviewed.

The 2023 column also presents a US$ convenience translation of the acquisitions line (printed US$ column; e.g. the row value carried in the table as (31,019.5 ) with the US$ column header). It is a translation of the NT$ amount into U.S. dollars and was not extracted as a separate record under the TWD-denominated metric mapping.

The exact NT$ literals are presented with a space between the closing amount and the accounting closing parenthesis in the source layout; the raw literals were preserved as-is without rescaling or sign normalization.

No aggregate investing cash flow, management CapEx summary or lease-addition figure was substituted for this metric; the 'Net cash used in investing activities' line in the same table is a different measure and is not extracted here.
Whether the 2023 fiscal year is a 52/53-week period, restatement status, and any Note 3 translation-rate details referenced by the header '(Note 3)' are not established by the supplied blocks.
